items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: He played with the old Arnowitz down here like on Carnival Days and Labor Day for the Long Showmans

ctx.x: So he did play down here then too, so...
Oh yeah, he played with several of the bands. He played with the old Arnowitz down here like on Carnival Days and Labor Day for the Long Showmans, you know, and brass bands.
Did they have a brass band up there that never had many parades or anything right in Thibodeau that you remember when you were a kid?
